<div class="doc"><h1>PokéSurvivor news</h1><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-16">2026-11-16</time><h2>More experience, Surf and fixes</h2><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>In-run upgrade cards with no limit: Vigor, Power, Sprint, Reflexes, Armor, Synthesis, Magnet, Critical Eye, Brutal Blow, Hunter and Quick Power can come up as many times as you like, so you can build however you want, and your damage to Arceus counts in full on the ranking. Learning now goes up to 15. Reflexes and Quick Power take off a little less each time (cooldowns never reach zero), damage reduction stays at 80% at most and crits keep their caps.</li><li>Damage reduction (Armor, items and upgrades) now also protects you from Arceus&#x27;s attacks, but much less: 30% at most, and only with reduction maxed out (80%); with half, half. Maxed out, a pillar that takes 35% of your health is cut to 24.5%. Touching him still takes the same.</li><li>More experience: each level needs 25% less than before (experience goes from ×3 to ×4).</li><li>In a group, a locked chest no longer gives everyone a full level: half a level with two players, a third with three and a quarter with four. Solo, it still gives one level.</li><li>Surf toned down: the wave travels less far (360 instead of 560), is narrower and deals 60% less damage.</li><li>Arceus&#x27;s Gravity: while it lasts, Arceus stays still (before, it chased you while you were slowed and caught you). First it does its gravity animation, then another for each wave of pillars.</li><li>Each Pokémon&#x27;s card now says how much HP it starts a run with: evolved Pokémon start with the strength of their first stage and reach their own at level 40, and those that don&#x27;t evolve start with 65% of their stats.</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>Pokémon that start already evolved now hit with their own side from the start: Gallade, Lucario or Volcarona, with their first stage&#x27;s strength, hit with the opposite side until level 40.</li><li>Darmanitan&#x27;s Zen Mode (Galarian too) only triggers with the Zen Mode ability: it triggered with any ability.</li><li>Rifts: if the Luminous Orb runs out inside the arena, the camera goes back to the arena view (it stayed too close); and if you leave with it still on, the view stays wide until it runs out.</li><li>Rifts can no longer appear in an enclosed spot you can&#x27;t walk to, or behind a gap too narrow for big Pokémon.</li><li>Rifts on mobile: the arena floor no longer stays black in patches when you enter (it redraws in a moment), and the game frees the floor memory it no longer uses sooner.</li><li>Radar Goggles: the minimap is much lighter, and on mobile it redraws 10 times per second (it lowered the FPS).</li><li>With a connected controller that moves on its own (drift, or a wheel or pedals), the Collection and Shop lists no longer scroll by themselves: in menus, the stick counts again once you let go of it.</li><li>Co-op: a connection drop of a few seconds between two players no longer splits the run in two (each kept playing alone, seeing the other standing still), and when it comes back, what happened in the meantime arrives (new enemies are no longer missing).</li><li>In a group, the end-screen «Against Arceus» time uses the same clock as the run time: it could come out longer than it really was.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-15">2026-11-15</time><h2>Purchases that stick</h2><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>With an account, eggs (from the gacha, missions and rifts) go straight to your account: a mission&#x27;s egg arrives a few seconds after claiming it, and a rift&#x27;s when the run ends.</li><li>Rifts: legendaries&#x27; whirlwinds (Gust, Whirlpool, Fire Spin…) move slower and pull you in less.</li><li>Surf deals 28% less damage: it now hits like the other area moves.</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>If you didn&#x27;t have enough tickets or coins to pull in the gacha or bet in the casino, the game kept showing the ones you didn&#x27;t have. Now it shows the real ones.</li><li>With an account, when buying several upgrades or items in quick succession, one could vanish a moment later and the coins came back: the game briefly showed the coins of a purchase that was still being saved. Now every purchase sticks and the coins are the real ones.</li><li>If the connection failed right as a run started, its minutes didn&#x27;t count towards Mastery and a rescued Pokémon could briefly vanish at the end. Now the game tries again.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-14">2026-11-14</time><h2>More experience</h2><h3>New</h3><ul><li>Wisdom, a new rare level-up card: +15% experience this run (once per run).</li></ul><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>With an account, buying (upgrades, Kecleon Shop, trails, skins, photos and frames) needs a connection, like the gacha and the casino. A run’s coins and tickets arrive when it ends.</li><li>Modes: Normal is a bit easier (enemies and bosses with a little less health and damage, and no hit takes more than a quarter of your health) and Nightmare a bit harder (more health and damage, harder hits and more enemies at once). Arceus&#x27;s Judgment doesn&#x27;t change on Normal.</li><li>You level up 3 times faster: each level needs a third of the experience it used to, in every mode.</li><li>Mid-run evolution moves to levels 20 and 40 (it was 12 and 24): with the new experience, it comes at about the same minute as before. The same for the boosts of Pokémon that don&#x27;t evolve.</li><li>With an account, the Rocket Casino and hatching eggs need a connection, like the gacha. The tickets you pick up in a run are saved when it ends; if the game closes halfway, you get them when you come back.</li><li>In a group, Munchlax&#x27;s gift is one for each: it appears at each player&#x27;s feet and only they can pick it up (before, whoever gave the last berry took them all).</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>Heavy-Duty Boots, Punching Glove and Safety Goggles in your Bag are no longer lost when playing on two devices or in two tabs.</li><li>When you pick up an item while already holding one, you now get two clear options: take the new one or keep yours (before, the key number showed on your item and looked like it meant keeping it).</li><li>Eggs of regional forms (Alolan Sandshrew, Hisuian Zorua, Galarian Zigzagoon…) now hatch: before, they stayed unhatched even when ready.</li><li>Co-op: if the host leaves when the rest of you have already picked your level-up card, the run goes on (before, it froze for everyone).</li><li>Rocket Casino: without a connection the exit no longer stays locked in Hidden Voltorb, and a brief network drop no longer costs you your win against Pikachu.</li><li>Co-op: the run no longer stays paused forever with «X is choosing…» when X had already chosen. It happened when picking up an item with another choice open (another item, evolution, a bond…) and, every time, with Munchlax&#x27;s gift, which leaves one item per player and one player picked them all up back to back. Now each item waits its turn.</li><li>With four items (Fourth Item card), the 5 key, «Keep the ones I have», now works, and the title says you can hold four. When evolving, the keys work for every card (Eevee has more than four).</li><li>If the browser restarted its graphics (the whole page flickering), the ground turned black in patches and trees, rocks and attacks stopped showing, sometimes until reloading the page. Now they redraw themselves.</li><li>With the game in Chinese, opening the Wardrobe of some Pokémon (Pikachu, for example) no longer freezes the screen.</li><li>Controller: your power (Mega, Dynamax, Z or Terastal) moves to the B button, and X always uses the selected orb (with the power ready, X didn&#x27;t use it).</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-13">2026-11-13</time><h2>The Big Update</h2><h3>New</h3><ul><li>Eternamax Eternatus, the new minute-20 boss, and a huge one: the sky turns red and a three-phase fight begins, with cores linked by a laser barrier, Toxic puddles, the Infinite Vortex that drags you in and a final strike, the Eternamax Beam. If you fall, the run is over; if you win, you choose a power for the rest of the run.</li><li>The powers, each with its own animation (F key, X on a controller or its own button on mobile): Mega Evolution (double ones too, like Charizard X and Y), Dynamax or Gigantamax, Z-Ring and Terastal.</li><li>Dynamax and Gigantamax, big time: your Pokémon becomes a giant, smashes trees, rocks and walls, crushes regular Pokémon and leaves rubble behind. The 32 that can, in their Gigantamax form.</li><li>Z-Ring: for 15 s a huge Z of your type rolls toward the enemies and, when it ends, the Z-Move sweeps the whole screen. Terastal: a crystal body and a crown with its type&#x27;s emblem.</li><li>All 1025 species: the 59 missing Pokémon arrive and none are left without a shiny.</li><li>388 new forms: regional forms as new Pokémon (Alolan Vulpix, Galarian Meowth, Hisuian Growlithe…), fusions and power forms as Eternatus rewards (Necrozma, Kyurem, Calyrex, Zacian…), forms you pick after the 3rd rift (Deoxys, Rotom, Oricorio…), battle forms (Aegislash, Wishiwashi, Mimikyu…) and cosmetic ones.</li><li>Evolution mid-run: at levels 12 and 24 you choose to evolve or keep its look (only its stats go up). Pokémon that don&#x27;t evolve get stronger too.</li><li>73 new moves: 39 signature moves for their own Pokémon (special card from level 10) and 34 TMs with new ways to attack (Earthquake, Surf, Thunder, Protect…). And about 60 moves get a new look.</li><li>Rift legendaries now really fight: three phases, attacks that move across the arena (five per type) and their ultimate attack.</li><li>Team Rocket: in one of every three long runs they take your Pokémon to their casino, with a slot machine, Hidden Voltorb, races and Catch Pikachu!, whose prize is the exclusive Obsidian Mewtwo skin (solo only).</li><li>Wardrobe, in the menu: for each Pokémon, normal or shiny version, look, skin, effects and trail.</li><li>56 trails for what your Pokémon leaves behind as it moves: buy one once and it works for all your Pokémon.</li><li>27 new skins made by the community: 3 every week in the Kecleon Shop, the same for everyone (Mail Carrier Dragonite, Cosmic Rayquaza, Living Neon Zygarde…). Some also come in shiny or Mega Evolved.</li><li>New profile, with a photo (a Pokémon&#x27;s face with the expression you choose) and a frame, also shown in the menu. In the Kecleon Shop, new photos every day and frames, trails and skins every week.</li><li>Mastery for each Pokémon: earn points for enemies defeated and minutes played with it. Rewards: its photo, the “… Master” title, a golden frame and the master aura.</li><li>Eggs: from weekly missions, the gacha (every 10 ×10 pulls) and rifts; they hatch in the Bag and can be shiny.</li><li>Weekly challenge: the same map, Pokémon and condition for everyone, with its own leaderboard and a single attempt per week (used up when you start), and a ×10 ticket if you last 3 minutes. From Monday the 16th, new conditions: every weather, “All …-type”, “No healing” and “Pitch-black night”.</li><li>Three difficulties: Normal, Hard (×1.5 coins and tickets) and Nightmare (×2). Beat Eternatus to unlock the next one.</li><li>13 new items, including the Radar Goggles, with a minimap. New upgrades: Second item (carry two at once) and Starting item. And run items are now on sale in the Kecleon Shop.</li><li>Blank TM, in the Kecleon Shop: erase a TM you taught a Pokémon.</li><li>Seen and defeated Pokédex in the Collection. And aura, glow and cry for all 1025 Pokémon.</li><li>New main menu, no scrolling, with the difficulty and the challenge in view. And a new end-of-run screen, with Play again right away, in a room too.</li><li>Settings: every computer key can be changed (two per action), FPS limit and options for effects and trails.</li><li>Map bosses are marked with an arrow at the edge of the screen when you can&#x27;t see them, with their distance.</li><li>Your profile shows how many hours you&#x27;ve played (counted from this update on).</li><li>Move Deleter: a card that can show up when you level up. Remove a move and put another of your Pokémon&#x27;s moves in its slot, or leave it empty: build the set you want, even if it evolves and changes type.</li><li>New event: Hungry Munchlax. It wants 3 berries of one kind: shake the bushes (you can see which berries each one has), bring them to it and it leaves you an item and an Exp. Candy. The ones it doesn&#x27;t want are yours. Careful: some bushes hide a swarm of Combee.</li><li>Arceus&#x27;s Judgment now takes place in the Hall of Origin: a marble-and-gold platform floating over a sea of clouds, with pillars of light and stars.</li><li>Arceus, the final boss, with many more attacks that join in as the Judgment goes on: Extreme Speed, Future Sight, Gravity, Hyper Beam and the Plate Judgment; and all his attacks look much flashier.</li><li>Arceus&#x27;s Golden Wheels: from minute 5 of the Judgment, its golden wheels race around the Hall of Origin like a circuit, near the edge and with gaps to cross; at minute 7, a second lane further in, spinning the other way. They take 35 % of your HP and knock you out of the lane.</li><li>The ranking shows each player&#x27;s photo and frame (in groups, everyone&#x27;s, each with their Pokémon), and your frame also shows on your photo at the top of the menu.</li><li>New ranking: it starts from scratch with the Big Update (the all-time board too).</li><li>New guides, in Settings → Guides: the whole game explained, with a front page and a background of Pokémon strolling around. Pokémon, moves (and the stat each one uses), items, upgrades, powers, final bosses, events and mastery.</li><li>Weekly challenge with a ranking: every week has its own board (in Ranking → Weekly challenge, or from the challenge button). Solo only.</li><li>Ranking: tap a record to see each player&#x27;s build: their Pokémon, level, moves with their level and the damage they dealt, and their items.</li><li>New level-up cards, all with a cap: Critical Eye (+2% crit, up to 20 times), Brutal Blow (+5% crit damage, up to 20), Hunter (more damage to bosses, legendaries and Eternatus), Dodge, Quick Power (less power cooldown) and Lucky Streak (more coins). Plus a very rare one, Fourth item, if you already hold 3 (Arceus breaks it at minute 8). Crits now have a cap: 60% chance and ×3.5 damage.</li><li>Mastery, in the menu (instead of Settings, still in the gear at the top): all your Pokémon from most to least mastery, with a search box, and each one&#x27;s page with its numbers: runs, time, defeated, Arceus reached, best time, bosses, rifts and Eternatus.</li></ul><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>The last rift (the one at minute 25) only gives a bond if you missed one of the earlier ones: the idea is to reach Eternatus having won all four.</li><li>Fairer boss fights: with lots of damage you take off more, but they no longer fall in one hit or skip their phases; and no single hit takes more than 30% of your health (Arceus aside).</li><li>General rebalance: bosses at minutes 2, 6, 10, 14 and 18, rifts at 4, 8, 12, 16 and 25, and a single difficulty curve. In co-op, each extra player only brings what they add.</li><li>Trails no longer come by default: you get them in the Kecleon Shop. Enemy bosses, legendaries and shinies keep theirs.</li><li>Trainer avatars are gone: your profile now has a photo and a frame.</li><li>The Kecleon Shop&#x27;s 8 daily TMs are the same for everyone.</li><li>Look, skin, effects and trail are now chosen in the Wardrobe (the Pokémon&#x27;s page has a button for it).</li><li>Protect: its cooldown no longer goes below 5 s.</li><li>A tougher Arceus&#x27;s Judgment: no more legendaries show up; Arceus doesn&#x27;t stop to attack, if you flee he teleports right in front of you and, if you make him jump several times, he rips out the move you flee with (Quick Attack, Agility and the ones that move you) and breaks it; the Hall of Origin cracks and gets holes you can&#x27;t step on; he breaks your items one by one (at 2, 4 and 6 minutes), and Protect, Sturdy and the Focus Sash don&#x27;t work against him. Reaching 10 minutes is the stuff of legends.</li><li>Veto: you can now block up to 5 moves (3 before), now that there are so many.</li><li>When you find an item with all slots full: the new one is shown on top and your items in a row, so you tap the one you swap. And the level-up menu no longer gets wider sometimes.</li><li>Judgment of Arceus: tougher from the start (Arceus catches up with you sooner and hits a bit harder), and the floor starts breaking sooner and a bit more. It also breaks differently now: cracks of golden light and marble slabs falling into the clouds.</li><li>When Arceus breaks the move you flee with, you can&#x27;t move while it happens (in co-op, the game goes on for the others).</li><li>In co-op, when Arceus breaks someone&#x27;s move, the whole group sees it: a golden beam holds them and a message shows their name and the move.</li><li>Judgment of Arceus: items break at 2, 4 and 6 minutes (before: 0:15, 2:30 and 5:00), and the ones that give Pokécoins (Amulet Coin, Exp. Charm, Luck Incense) still give them at the end even if they break.</li><li>Judgment of Arceus in co-op: if you fall and get revived, nothing happens; but if you fall again, Arceus stops to judge you in front of everyone and you can&#x27;t be revived anymore.</li><li>The shop no longer sells items that give experience (the Exp. Charm); if you already have one, you can still use it.</li><li>Beams no longer end in a straight cut: their tips are rounded, the ones falling from the sky fade out at the top, and beam warnings on the ground are rounded.</li><li>Homing moves (Energy Ball, Ice Shard, Shadow Sneak, Moonblast…) chase much less: they turn half as hard, start looking for targets closer and only go after what is in front of them (they no longer turn around).</li><li>On mobile, orbs now sit to the right of your moves (in a 2×2 block if a row doesn&#x27;t fit), and in co-op the “You&#x27;re down” notice and its button to watch a teammate no longer end up under them.</li><li>The Judgment of Arceus is harder from the start: Arceus matches your speed after the first minute and is faster than you by minute 3, unlocks a new attack every 30 s (all of them by 2:30), attacks more often, its pillars and beams give less warning, and the floor breaks faster and up to 30 %.</li><li>The ultimate attack of rift legendaries: you now hide behind the arena&#x27;s own pillars, trees and rocks (no more crystals), and you don&#x27;t need to be positioned perfectly.</li><li>When you level up you now choose between 4 cards instead of 3.</li><li>On the leaderboard you appear with the Pokémon you finish the run with (the evolved one, if it evolved), not the one you started with. Mastery still goes to the one you picked.</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>Co-op: if you change your partner (or to its shiny) in the Collection or the Wardrobe, the others now see the new one in the run; and if the connection drops, they no longer keep seeing you unevolved.</li><li>Profile: your friends now see your picture and your frame.</li><li>Co-op: Arceus arrives at minute 30 even if the fight against Eternatus hasn&#x27;t ended (some groups never got the Judgment).</li><li>Mew&#x27;s and Sylveon&#x27;s eyes no longer turn white with their glow.</li><li>Co-op: Eternamax Eternatus brings the whole group into its arena (only the host went in, and everyone else was left with frozen enemies and a stuck run).</li><li>Collection: deleting a letter while searching for a Pokémon no longer closes the screen.</li><li>Veto: all 5 vetoed moves are now kept (they dropped to 3 when you came back), and erasing a TM with a Blank TM also removes its veto instead of taking up a slot.</li><li>Mobile: the music no longer sounds choppy or “robotic” when there are lots of Pokémon on screen.</li><li>In a room, if the host started another run while you were still on the summary, you were left out: now you join.</li><li>In a group, when you get back up you have 2 seconds where nothing can hurt you: in some areas you got knocked down again right away.</li><li>Arceus&#x27;s Judgment: your attacks target him when he&#x27;s the closest (with legendaries alive he was never hit) and his damage numbers show; hitting him no longer heals (drain moves, Shell Bell); Dynamax no longer refills your HP during the Judgment; in co-op, Arceus chased guests slower than they ran.</li><li>Run summary: your Pokémon now shows in the form you were using (Original Magearna...) and its costume, not the default one.</li><li>From minute 12 the map switched to the colours (and puddles) of the rift arenas; now it keeps cycling Forest, Cave and Volcano.</li><li>If your Pokémon evolves after choosing its power, the power adapts to the new one (before, it could stop working).</li><li>More fixes: ×100 pulls count towards the gacha egg; beating Eternatus on a harder mode (for example, as a guest) also unlocks the earlier ones; Safety Goggles also protect you from sandstorm and snow chip damage; the lost Pokémon shows its time and it doesn&#x27;t run out inside rifts; the challenge summary shows the full condition; the “Divine Challenge” achievement now asks you to survive 5 minutes against Arceus; Rapid Strike Urshifu has its own Water-type Gigantamax; and Kyogre and Groudon say “Primal Reversion”.</li><li>Texts that stayed in Spanish with the game in another language: «Lv.» with its number (on the health bar, the cards and the pause screen), the Profile button and screen, each Pokémon&#x27;s upgrade levels and the pictures &amp; frames tab in the Kecleon Shop. And when you level up, key 4 also shows in the hint.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-12">2026-11-12</time><h2>Long runs on mobile</h2><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>On mobile, in long runs: it no longer runs out of memory for sprite effects. Before, at some point the run would end («The game crashed») or Pokémon would show only their shadow until you reloaded.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-08">2026-11-08</time><h2>Co-op without cut-offs</h2><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>Co-op: if the host leaves or loses connection, the run no longer ends. Another player becomes the host and you carry on together; if that&#x27;s not possible, each of you carries on with your own run and everything you had. (A run that changes host doesn&#x27;t go on the leaderboard.)</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>Co-op: a player with no connection (phone off or no wifi) can no longer revive a teammate, keep the run alive when everyone else is down, pick up items or make more enemies appear; and nobody has to wait for them to choose level-up cards.</li><li>Co-op: if the host switches tabs or stops responding, you&#x27;re no longer stuck forever: after 30 seconds the run goes on.</li><li>The save dot next to your name no longer turns red because of a single connection hiccup: it retries straight away and only turns red when there&#x27;s really no connection. (Your progress was never lost: it stays in the browser and is uploaded later.)</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-07">2026-11-07</time><h2>Group leaderboard</h2><h3>New</h3><ul><li>Countdown to the Big Update in the menu: tap it to watch the trailer.</li></ul><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>&quot;Friends only&quot; in Daily, Weekly and Monthly now shows your friends&#x27; 50 best scores, even outside the world top 50. You also see your rank when you&#x27;re outside the top 50.</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>Group runs weren&#x27;t entering the leaderboard: they now upload when the run ends.</li><li>Scores, including your friends&#x27;, now show up on the leaderboard within minutes instead of hours.</li><li>If your connection fails at the end of a run, your score is sent again; and if it doesn&#x27;t get in, we now tell you.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-05">2026-11-05</time><h2>Automatic saving</h2><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>The Save button is gone: your progress now saves by itself.</li><li>Your progress now saves by itself after each run and when you upgrade or buy. If you play on several devices, they catch up when you come back to the game.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-04">2026-11-04</time><h2>Gacha needs a connection</h2><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>With an account, gacha pulls need an internet connection. As a guest, and for playing and shopping, nothing changes.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-11-02">2026-11-02</time><h2>Your progress, safe</h2><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>Some players lost what they had played in the last few days after an update: if the browser opened an older version of the game again (from its cache or an old tab), that version didn&#x27;t recognize the copy of the save kept by the browser and went back to the last one in the cloud. That no longer happens. And if the game ever can&#x27;t read that copy, it no longer deletes it: it keeps it aside and recovers it by itself after updating.</li><li>Offline, the game installed as an app opens the last version you used, not the one from when you installed it.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-31">2026-10-31</time><h2>News on mobile too</h2><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>The menu news banner (Discord, latest video...) now also shows on phones in landscape: at the top left, above the title and your partner.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-30">2026-10-30</time><h2>Official Discord and against cheating</h2><h3>New</h3><ul><li>News banner at the top left of the menu: it cycles through the important news (there&#x27;s an official Discord now!) and the channel&#x27;s latest video (tap it to open it on YouTube).</li></ul><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>The new video notice no longer plays the video inside the game: &quot;Watch on YouTube&quot; (or tapping the thumbnail) opens it on YouTube.</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>The Discord link in the menu banner said &quot;invalid invite&quot;. Not anymore.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-27">2026-10-27</time><h2>Steadier co-op</h2><h3>New</h3><ul><li>Mobile and tablet: new &quot;Anchored&quot; joystick (Settings → Controls → Place the buttons). It appears where you put your finger and stays in that spot while you hold it, even if you move your finger away; lift it and touch somewhere else, and it appears there. The usual &quot;Floating&quot; one follows your finger and is still the default.</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>Weak Armor, Steadfast and Rattled no longer remove your Agility charges (or any better speed boost) when you get hit: they used to drop them to one.</li><li>The Assault Vest no longer counts toward the 70% cap of the Armor cards: with the cards maxed, the vest adds on top. And if you take it off, you keep what the cards gave you.</li><li>In very elongated windows (very wide and short), enemies no longer keep looping off screen without coming closer: it looked as if none were spawning.</li><li>Starting quiz: your personality traits (&quot;Patient&quot;, &quot;Tenacious&quot;…) were shown in Spanish in every language. They are translated now.</li><li>Arceus damage leaderboard: &quot;Friends only&quot; also shows friends outside the top 50 (in All-time); All-time keeps your best damage even if that run does not beat your time; and if a run cannot enter the leaderboard, it now tells you.</li><li>Leaderboard: since the night of October 26, many runs did not make it into the leaderboard (they did show in your profile). The game now tries harder when preparing them for the leaderboard and they get in as usual.</li><li>Mobile: tapping &quot;Change options&quot; on the level-up cards sometimes picked one of the new cards by itself; and in a bond, after choosing the first move, whichever move ended up under your finger was joined instead of the one you tapped. Now only the card you tap is chosen.</li><li>Co-op: on some networks you could only play when one particular person was the host; with someone else hosting, the others kept &quot;reconnecting&quot; forever. Now, if the direct connection does not work, the server connection of either player is tried (not just the host&#x27;s), and it is prepared as soon as you join the room so no time is lost.</li><li>Co-op: with a slow connection, a player could see the run minutes late (more than 4 minutes behind the others), and Arceus&#x27;s Judgment turned into chaos. Now, if the connection cannot keep up, the game waits for it to catch up instead of piling up what has yet to arrive: at worst the run pauses for a moment (&quot;waiting for the host&quot;), but it is always up to date.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-26">2026-10-26</time><h2>Halloween is coming</h2><h3>New</h3><ul><li>Halloween event from October 30 to November 2 (Spain time). If you tapped a card with one finger while holding the joystick with the other, the card was not chosen and everything stayed frozen with the cards open. Now it is chosen when you lift your finger on it, whether or not another finger is on the screen (item and bond cards too). And if the phone misses that you lifted your finger, the joystick lets go by itself as soon as no finger is left on the screen.</li><li>The top bar (coins, tickets, candy, your name and the buttons) fits on any screen. Before, with everything showing, on many screens (tablets too) the coins and tickets went off the left edge and the buttons split into two lines. During a run it pauses, on a menu screen it goes back to the menu, and only on the main menu does it leave the site. And if you pull down the notification shade or another app opens on top, the run also pauses (when playing solo).</li><li>Mobile: the messages in the middle of the screen (the orb ones, for example) went off both sides and could not be read. Now they wrap and fit.</li><li>Mobile: the notices at the bottom (achievements and messages) no longer catch your taps. Now it stops and comes back when you return to the game.</li><li>Cloud save: if you got tickets, coins or Pokémon on one device and saved on another one in the meantime, back on the first one the game thought everything was already saved (&quot;Everything is already saved in the cloud&quot;) and did not upload it, so it never showed up on the other device. Now it checks what is really missing and Save uploads it.</li><li>Cloud save: after spending on one device tickets or coins that had already been spent on another, your tickets could keep growing on their own every time you saved, and then suddenly drop on the other device. Now the balance is the same everywhere, and nothing you earn afterwards is taken away.</li><li>Cloud save: if there was no connection yet when the game opened (it sometimes happens on phones), you played with the copy stored on that device, which could be old, until you pressed Save: what you got on other devices was missing. Now, as soon as the connection is back, the cloud copy is brought in and merged with yours.</li><li>Arceus&#x27;s Judgment: going very fast you could get out of the arena, where neither Arceus nor the legendaries could reach you, so you survived forever. Now nobody leaves the arena.</li><li>Co-op: if a teammate lost connection or their phone switched off, their Pokémon stood still on the map and enemies and Arceus kept chasing it without hurting it, so nobody else got hit. Now, after 3 seconds without hearing from them, they go after the players still in the game.</li><li>Ranking: the best runs (more than 12 defeated per second) were never uploaded, without any warning: the server rejected them entirely. Now they are always uploaded.</li><li>Ranking: weekly, monthly and all-time now match each other. Each one was loaded separately and all-time could still be missing a time already shown in weekly.</li><li>Friends ranking: daily, weekly and monthly only show friends who are in the top 50; it now says so instead of &quot;No records here yet&quot;. All-time shows everyone.</li><li>All-time ranking: if your time did not make the top 50, the ranking kept showing your old one for hours, and checking your rank could let a worse run replace the better one that had not been uploaded yet. Now your best time shows up right away and is never lost.</li><li>With the game open in two tabs of the same browser, what you get or spend in one is no longer lost when you use the other: both share their changes right away.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-24">2026-10-24</time><h2>Moves in the collection and menu windows</h2><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>Collection: the icons of the moves each Pokémon can learn are twice as big and, when you hover over them (or tap them on mobile), they show their type, whether they are physical or special, and what they do.</li><li>The menu windows, Settings, What&#x27;s new and Support can be closed by clicking outside them, as well as with Back or Close.</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>The Kecleon Shop and What&#x27;s new windows no longer slide under the top bar: they now start below it, like the other windows.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-23">2026-10-23</time><h2>Arceus damage ranking and Plates</h2><h3>New</h3><ul><li>YouTube button at the top, next to What&#x27;s new: it takes you to the game&#x27;s channel and, when there is a live stream, it turns red with &quot;LIVE&quot; and takes you to watch it.</li><li>The ranking is now split in two: on the left, the damage you dealt to Arceus; on the right, the time survived, as always. Maxed and evolved it dealt almost twice as much as Rock Slide; now they are on par.</li><li>In Arceus&#x27;s Judgment, poison and burns deal a small, fixed amount to the legendaries (poison used to take a % of their HP): poisoning them and running away no longer works, you have to hit them.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-22">2026-10-22</time><h2>Mystery Dungeon orbs, Shiny Charms and ×100 gacha</h2><h3>New</h3><ul><li>Mystery Dungeon orbs: single-use items you find during the run (chests, bosses and sometimes when you defeat a Pokémon). Slumber Orb, Slow Orb and Blowback Orb put enemies to sleep, slow them down or blow them away; Focus Orb, Luminous Orb and Quick Orb give critical hits, a wider view or speed to you and nearby teammates. You carry up to 4 different ones (3 of each) and use them with keys 5-8, by tapping their slot above your moves, or with X / Y on a controller. Bosses and legendaries are less affected.</li><li>Shiny Charms: one per region (Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar and Paldea). You can find them in your Bag, along with how many you still need for each one. Among them Hyper Beam, Solar Beam, Magnitude, Whirlpool, Thunder Wave, Outrage, Play Rough, Sucker Punch... each with its evolution.</li><li>New ways to attack: shots that chase enemies or bounce between them, beams you charge up, spins that hit everything around you, shockwaves that travel along the ground, vortexes that pull enemies in, waves that push them away and zones that stun them.</li><li>New upgrade, Starting move: buy it once per Pokémon and then choose for free which move it starts the run with.</li><li>New languages: French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, in Settings &gt; Graphics &gt; Language. Physical moves use its Attack and special moves its Special Attack: Machamp hits hard with Karate Chop and weakly with Shadow Ball. With moves on its strong side it hits as hard as before. When leveling up, each card says whether the move is physical or special and how well it works with your Pokémon, and the collection shows all its stats.</li><li>Swords Dance and Dragon Dance now raise only (physical) Attack, like in the games, and Nasty Plot arrives, raising Special Attack, learnable by any Pokémon. It is off by default.</li><li>Save button at the top right: it uploads your game to the cloud right away. Use it before closing the game or switching devices.</li></ul><h3>Changes</h3><ul><li>Level-up, bond and item cards can’t be picked for a moment after they appear (they look dimmed): pressing 1-4 or tapping to switch attacks mid-fight no longer picks a card by accident.</li><li>With a controller you can now select the Pokémon you don’t have yet in the collection, and on mobile the Settings tabs fit in one row that scrolls sideways.</li><li>Your game is saved to the cloud automatically every 10 minutes.</li><li>All-time leaderboard: if you are below rank 1,000, it shows “#1000+” instead of the exact number.</li><li>Big Pokémon (Onix, Gyarados, Wailord, Eternatus, the legendaries...) are now properly playable: they look a bit smaller, while still being among the biggest, and collide like a normal one, so they fit through every corridor and don’t take extra hits because of their size.</li><li>There are at most 3 healers, 3 shielders and 3 summoners at a time.</li><li>Healers and shielders no longer make a boss unkillable: their healing and shields scale with the damage you are dealing to it, and it only gets one shield every 6 seconds.</li><li>Judgment of Arceus: speed has a soft cap (anything above a certain point counts much less) and legendaries run almost as fast as you. After 5 minutes of Judgment, Arceus keeps speeding up, and after 7 its touch takes more and more HP, until it knocks you out in one hit around minute 40.</li><li>Poison still takes a percentage of HP, but against enemies with huge HP (the Judgment legendaries) that percentage is smaller.</li><li>All leaderboards start from scratch (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and all-time): records from running away from Arceus could no longer be reached.</li></ul><h3>Fixes</h3><ul><li>Security: we closed a hole that let someone put code in their leaderboard row or profile and make it run in the browser of whoever opened them (some people were sent to a video). You lose nothing: that run’s coins, tickets, records and leaderboard entry are saved as if you had quit.</li></ul></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-14">2026-10-14</time><h2>Place the buttons your way on mobile</h2><p>In Settings &gt; Controls &gt; Place the buttons you can drag the attacks, the pause button and the joystick wherever you want, and choose a fixed joystick.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-14">2026-10-14</time><h2>The only official website is pokesurvivor.com</h2><p>PokéSurvivor is and always will be free. From today the game’s code is under a non-commercial license (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0).</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-14">2026-10-14</time><h2>Recover your account with Gmail</h2><p>If you play with a name and password, you can now link your Gmail: if you forget your password, sign in with Google and it is the same account.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-13">2026-10-13</time><h2>The Judgment of Arceus</h2><p>At minute 30, Arceus descends from the sky and takes you to the Ruins of Judgment: it is invincible, chases you faster and faster, and every 5 seconds a legendary joins with twice the HP and damage of the previous one. Three new achievements, new music, and the all-time leaderboard starts from scratch.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-12">2026-10-12</time><h2>Endless runs, less random rifts and a &quot;What&#x27;s new&quot; screen</h2><p>Fixed the bug that turned the screen black or levelled you up forever after 84 minutes; if something fails, the run saves itself. Rifts show up at least every 2.5 minutes and the legendaries you are missing appear more often. Healers heal based on how hard you hit, with a cap. In co-op, if the host switches tabs the run pauses for everyone. iPhone fixes, a shiny toggle in the menu, stronger melee attacks and a &quot;What&#x27;s new&quot; button inside the game.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-11">2026-10-11</time><h2>Bonds: fuse moves by defeating legendaries</h2><p>Every legendary you defeat in a rift gives you a bond: link two moves so they fire at the same time from a single slot, and each further legendary adds another one, up to 4 at once. That frees slots to learn more moves. Rifts also show up more often.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-10">2026-10-10</time><h2>Bosses with several attacks, 8 new move kinds and a tougher game</h2><p>Bosses and legendaries have 4 telegraphed attacks, close in or fight from range and get enraged at half health. 12 new moves and 8 new ways to attack: boomerang, chain, mines, meteors, turret, dash, trail and spray. Fewer but tougher enemies, mid-run events (single-type hordes, golden hour, lost Pokémon), Meowth running away loaded with coins, Water types swim at full speed and the leaderboard has anti-cheat.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-09">2026-10-09</time><h2>Mobile, English and settings</h2><p>You can now play on phones and tablets with a touch joystick, in English and Spanish, and install it as an app. New settings screen with automatic graphics quality, and fewer but stronger enemies on screen.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-08">2026-10-08</time><h2>Missions, achievements and enemies with personality</h2><p>Daily and weekly missions, 127 achievements with medals and titles, a public profile, held items, move evolutions and enemies that heal, shield, summon or explode.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-08">2026-10-08</time><h2>Legendary rifts and weather</h2><p>Rifts leading to 18 legendary arenas, one per type; weather that changes the fight; a type chart and a slot-machine gacha with tickets.</p></article><article class="news"><time datetime="2026-10-08">2026-10-08</time><h2>Co-op and leaderboards</h2><p>Online co-op for up to 4 with your friends list, plus daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and all-time leaderboards.</p></article><p class="cta"><a class="btn" href="../../en/">Play free</a></p></div>
